upstream.description: Lucid Agents Commerce SDK. Bootstrap AI agents in 60 seconds that can pay, sell, and participate in agentic commerce supply chains. Our protocol agnostic SDK provides CLI-generated templates and drop-in adapters for Hono, Express, Next.js, and TanStack, giving you instant access to crypto/fiat payment rails (AP2, A2A, x402, ERC8004).

classification.analysis: Lucid Agents (repo name money-Ai-agents) is a TypeScript-first, protocol-agnostic framework and CLI for building and monetizing AI agents, with native support for x402 payments, A2A agent-to-agent communication, and ERC-8004 onchain identity. It's a composable monorepo — a protocol-agnostic core runtime plus optional extensions (http, payments, wallets, identity, a2a, ap2) and framework adapters (Hono, Express, Next.js, TanStack) — letting a developer scaffold a paid agent with `bunx @lucid-agents/cli` and accept USDC on Base or Solana out of the box. It targets developers experimenting with agentic commerce and agent marketplaces; the low star/fork count and thin adoption signal an early-stage, still-maturing project rather than production infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a paid AI agent that accepts USDC crypto payments in minutes
